records.title: 178th Wing Base Microgrid Construction
records.buyer_or_issuer: DEPT OF DEFENSE / DEPT OF THE ARMY / NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU
records.overview: SAM.gov solicitation for 178th Wing base microgrid construction. The notice describes a base bid for natural gas generators, microgrid controls, and general work, with options for a PV solar array and battery energy storage system.
records.relevance_notes: Relevant to solar EPC, microgrid, and storage contractors because the official notice includes PV Solar Array and Battery Energy Storage System options.

records.title: USGS Communications Site Infrastructure IDIQ
records.buyer_or_issuer: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF / U.S. Geological Survey
records.overview: SAM.gov presolicitation notice for a USGS communications site infrastructure IDIQ. The scope includes maintenance, repair, and upgrades for radio communications sites, including generator and solar power systems, power distribution systems, and backup battery arrays.
records.relevance_notes: Relevant to contractors working on remote communications site power, solar power systems, backup battery arrays, and power distribution upgrades.

change_log.note: Initial non-published draft intake from approved SAM.gov source.

records.title: U.S. Army 63rd Readiness Division MILCON ERCIP Microgrid
records.buyer_or_issuer: DEPT OF DEFENSE / DEPT OF THE ARMY / U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
records.overview: SAM.gov solicitation for the U.S. Army 63rd Readiness Division MILCON ERCIP Microgrid in Mountain View, California. The notice describes a microgrid with full islanding capability, including a ground-mounted photovoltaic solar system, battery energy storage system, and diesel backup generation.
records.relevance_notes: Relevant as a closed SAM.gov draft example for microgrid, PV solar, and battery storage contractors. It must not be presented as an active opportunity because the response date has passed.

change_log.note: Initial non-published draft intake from approved SAM.gov source. Listed as closed because the response date has passed.
